productQuery.title: Product to search for
productQuery.description: Product name, ideally with the model number. The Actor searches Google, picks shop product pages and compares them. Ignored if you give product URLs below.

productUrls.title: Product page URLs (optional)
productUrls.description: Instead of searching, give the same product on two or more supplier sites yourself.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many units you want to buy. Used to compute totals.

requirements.title: Buyer requirements
requirements.description: Optional, in plain language, e.g. 'needed within 5 days, prefer EU suppliers'.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Optional. With a key, Claude writes the comparison and flags risks. Without one, you get a rule-based summary.

countryCode.title: Search country
countryCode.description: Google country to search in (e.g. cz, sk, de, pl).

searchSuffix.title: Search suffix
searchSuffix.description: Word added to the search to favour shop pages (e.g. 'cena' for Czech, 'price' for English). Leave empty to search the product name only.

maxShops.title: Max shops to compare
maxShops.description: How many shop pages to take from the search results (one per shop).

excludeDomains.title: Extra domains to skip
excludeDomains.description: Domains to ignore in search results, in addition to built-in marketplaces and price-comparison sites.

useProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useProxy.description: Route requests through Apify Proxy to avoid blocks.
